analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($66.10) vs SMA5/20/50 ($66.04/$66.46/$65.96) — Mixed trend diagnosed with short-term SMA5 above, mid-term SMA20/50 below.
· 9.86% above SMA100/200 ($62.72/$60.16) — Mid-to-long-term trend strength is sound.
· 52-week position (81.3%) + Historical significance near 52-week high at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.8→48.2) — Exited oversold, now sideways in neutral zone with weak directionality.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2154→-0.2776) — Weak convergence continues, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $66.98) — Sideways near the middle band, band width at 7.12% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($66.00) — Close to current price, based on Pivot (PP $66.28).
· Swing resistance ($68.35) — Approximately 3.3% above current price, near R1 ($68.65).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern — Sideways within the range of 5-day high ($66.85)/low ($63.91) and 20-day high ($68.83)/low ($63.91).
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.00x) — Moderate reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Lack of directionality due to neutral RSI and continued weak MACD convergence, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
